text:
jamal_csm: FYI — LatentAI just finished initial integration smoke tests. Few items to sync on enrollment and feedback capture.
latentai-eng: Thanks! Observed 502s on /health-check during load, only when batch size > 8. Not sure if it's our side or Redwood routing.
devon_se: can you paste the failure logs + request ids? Also which model config were you hitting? batch=8 vs 16 matters.
latentai-prod-lead: request id 01F2a9c3 - we're on model=gpt-open-13b-quant, seq=1024. We'll upload logs in a sec.
ashley_pm: Goal this week: get 5 pilot seats fully onboarded + initial NPS survey. Jamal — confirm call times for enablement.
jamal_csm: I put a Calendly block — https://calendly.com/jamal/latentai-onboard (Tue 11a PT / Wed 4p PT). Pick one.
ops_bot: deploy-notice: Canary rollout for model-variant gpt-open-13b-quant will start 2940002200, 10% traffic.
jamal_csm: noting potential overlap with their load tests. devon_se — can we pause canary for that window if we see regressions?
devon_se: yes — set a temporary rule: if error-rate > 1% within 15m we auto-rollback. I'll add it.
devon_se: added config: `rollback_if_error_rate: 0.01, window: 900s`
latentai-eng: re: feedback capture — can Redwood add a "session_id" token to events so we correlate logs with survey responses?
jamal_csm: @ashley_pm is there a lightweight knob for session_id passthrough?
ashley_pm: We can add a header `x-session-id` that flows through telemetry. Need engineering sign-off, low effort.
devon_se: trivial — we'll accept header and attach to events table. LatentAI — please include it in your test harness.
latentai-eng: done. We'll run a pass tonight and ping with results. Also we'll collect qualitative feedback from 3 power users and share.
jamal_csm: Perfect. Next steps: LatentAI to run tests + send failure logs (by EOD), Jamal to schedule enablement, Devon to monitor canary and set rollback. I'll send the survey template.
latentai-prod-lead: thanks all. One ask — can we get a sample of token-cost breakdown for the model at typical prompt sizes? Helps with renewal forecasting.
devon_se: I'll export token_cost_report for `gpt-open-13b-quant` with seq lengths 128/512/1024 and drop into the shared drive.
jamal_csm: I'll follow up after we have numbers. :thumbsup: 
latentai-eng: quick note — when we hit 502s we also saw KV-cache miss spikes. Any suggestions?
devon_se: could be overflow on concurrent KV writes, i'll enable an additional worker pool for cache writes and report back.
jamal_csm: Closing loop: ping me once tests done and when you pick Calendly slot.
